infopop.description: Work collaboratively with others and keep track of everything.

sections.title: Tasks
sections.text: Every member of your group can add tasks, unless your group's permissions say otherwise. Whether it's homework, a Dalton assignment or an exam – anything you need to keep track of for school can be added. All tasks are visible to the members of your group, so you can keep track of everything together. Open a task to see its description, files and notes.

sections.title: Adding tasks
sections.text: To add a task, click the + and choose the matching type (homework, Dalton or exam). Enter a title briefly describing the task and select the subject and due date. Optionally, you can add more details in the description or upload related media such as board photos, model solutions, notes or study sheets. Images, PDFs and Office files are supported.

sections.title: Uploading files
sections.text: You can also upload files to tasks created by others, even if you can't edit them. Open the task, click the 3-dot menu, select Add Images and choose the files. To remove files you uploaded, right-click or press and hold them and select Delete from the menu.

sections.title: Tracking completed tasks
sections.text: Use the checkbox to check off every task you've completed. That way you can easily see what's still left to do and what's already done. Your progress is saved to your account in the cloud. With the Hide completed filter you only see tasks you haven't completed yet.

sections.title: Personalized courses
sections.text: If you've saved which courses/electives you take, tasks for other courses that don't concern you can be hidden automatically, so you only see what really matters to you. You can adjust your selection in the group settings under My courses. If you still want to see all tasks, you can change the display option in your account menu.

sections.title: Archive
sections.text: Checked-off tasks are automatically hidden once their due date has passed to keep the view tidy – pinned tasks stay visible. If you're looking for an old task, you can turn on the Archive filter. You can also move tasks into and out of the archive manually using Archive and Unarchive in the menu. This only affects your own view.

sections.title: Only visible to you
sections.text: Unlike regular tasks, these are encrypted and only visible to you. This way you can also track personal tasks and to-dos – all within one app.

sections.title: Order
sections.text: Sort your tasks by importance. Move them up or down by pressing and dragging or via the menu in the list, so you can see your priorities at a glance.

sections.title: Security
sections.text: Your private tasks are stored encrypted with AES-256 on our server. Other users can't see them.
